answer: The kernel is a public referral graph plus escrow, stopping fakes: each new identity posts a 60 POA escrow and hangs from a sponsor branch in a willow, so origins stay visible. Honest work refunds it in 20 epochs. Any peer may dispute a fake with a fixed-form sonnet; proven fakes are slashed, challengers rewarded. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA, mostly slashed, while one honest identity pays 60 POA once and keeps its reward.
